text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both Mr. C.B. and Katsuragi Ace were 
defeated in the Japan Cup, left with deep 
frustration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, when Katsuragi Ace asks 
her what her next goal is, Mr. C.B. 
replies, "The Arima Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The grand stage where a showdown with 
Symboli Rudolf had once been promised. Mr. 
C.B. urges Katsuragi Ace to enter the race 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B., Symboli Rudolf, and Katsuragi 
Ace. The time had finally come for the 
three to clash in the Arima Kinen.
